name: Akane
source:
The ultimate athlete, she'll never say no to a challenge. Let's get fired up!

Akane can be quite blunt when speaking to others. This, combined with her piercing eyes and stand off-ish demeanor can make her quite intimidating.

Despite this, she can get flustered and shy at unexpected moments.
